rules.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.description: Detects exploitation of public-facing web applications, APIs, and services
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "mitre" or Message contains "initial-access" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Valid Accounts Usage
